paragraphs.text:
You bury Norman’s body, all too aware that you persuaded him 
to follow you on this expedition.

Putting aside that thought, you return to the dead ape-man 
in the cave. It is an incredible specimen.

You may attempt a First Aid roll: if you succeed, you may regain 
1D3 hit points lost in the last encounter. If you wish to take the 
creature’s head, record the keyword STOCKHOUSE. Then, go 
to 377.
